answer: For a poll on a summit trail in a hollow shown in the atlas, the server checks a frozen trust graph and poll-bound signatures. It counts one ballot per key with two edge-disjoint paths to a fixed seed and rejects invalid, repeated or ineligible ballots. An alias cluster linked to the rest by one edge cannot qualify; adding a second trusted link may cost recruitment effort. Collusion can supply links, and genuine voters behind a bridge are excluded.
